hints.content:
The point $(0,-5)$ lies in the shaded area of both of the inequalities.



[[☃ image 1]]

options.alt: A coordinate plane with a graphed system of inequalities. The x- and y-axes both scale by one. There is a dashed line representing an inequality that goes through the points negative three, negative one and zero, three. The shaded region for the inequality is below the line. There is another dashed line representing the second inequality that goes through the points zero, two and two, zero. The shaded region for this inequality is below the line. The point zero, five is plotted inside of the shaded region of both inequalities.

hints.content: Yes, $(0,-5)$ is a solution of the system of inequalities.
